reason: Pre-headline schema and reader validation showed that San Emidio level-0 is packaged as native DataCube .AU4 and SmartSolo .DLD waveform members. The public DataCube format has a reproducible official command-line decoder (GFZ GIPPtools cube2mseed), and a real San Emidio AU4 member was successfully decoded to raw INT32 counts in CI. The SmartSolo DLD path depends on proprietary SoloLite/DMC software in the authors' documented workflow. To keep the primary benchmark raw, public, automatable, and independently reproducible, San Emidio is frozen to its DataCube level-0 .AU4 subset only. This accessibility decision was made before any frozen headline survey compression result; no headline result was inspected or used.

land_san_emidio_2021.name: WHOLESCALE San Emidio Nevada 2021 DataCube raw level-0
land_san_emidio_2021.test_policy: 3x >=10GB deterministic spans over complete native DataCube level-0 .AU4 waveform members inside the public TAR archive
land_san_emidio_2021.note: Raw DataCube only. SmartSolo DLD is excluded solely because the documented conversion path depends on proprietary vendor tooling; processed SAC is not used.
